answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 5262 Country: India Title: Can women take bath during Haiz (Mensuration) period? Question: Can women take bath during Haiz (Mensuration) period? Answer ID: 5262 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 251/251=M) A woman can have bath during her menses, but this will be bathing for nazafah (neatness) only, it will not be bathing for taharah (cleanliness/purity). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
